Both leachate treatments also resulted in strong positive transcriptional responses in a large number of hli (high-light inducible) family genes. (p3, Results)
An uncharacterized, Prochlorococcus-specific transcriptional regulator (PMT9312_RS06030) was also very strongly upregulated under exposure to both leachates (p3, Results)

Among the set showing the highest fold change was a cluster of five genes (PMT9312_RS02820–40) encoding carbon dioxide concentrating mechanism protein CcmK, both RUBISCO subunits and carboxysome shell proteins. (p3, Results)

pathways.evidence: Transcription was strongly reduced for a number of MIT9312 carbon fixation associated genes on exposure to both leachates (p3, Results)
Genes involved in photosynthesis and light-harvesting also showed clear transcriptional level changes under both leachate exposures (p3, Results)
Other significant transcriptional changes observed in NATL2A include reduced transcription of genes involved with nitrogen metabolism under HDPE leachate exposure (p5, Results)
